races.title: All-Weather Championship Is Back Handicap
races.verdict: KEATS HOUSE has responded well to the blinkers and is taken to resume winning ways with Rhys Elliott taking a handy 5 lb off. Titainium will be a threat if able to build on his latest back-to-form fourth at Newcastle. Billy Loughnane's mount Burford Beauty is next on the list ahead of Good Karma , who can play a part if his stamina holds back up at a 1m. KEATS HOUSE (IRE) TITAINIUM BURFORD BEAUTY (IRE)

races.title: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict: This has the look of an interesting novice and it will probably go to a newcomer, with DEPUTY GENERAL and Highland Ranger arguably the most appealing pair before betting clues. Twice-raced Ring of Music surely has a race like this in him and won't be far away. DEPUTY GENERAL (USA) HIGHLAND RANGER RING OF MUSIC (IRE)

races.title: Midnite Building The Future Of Betting Handicap
races.verdict: Ollie Sangster 3-y-o RIDGER makes obvious appeal under Billy Loughnane. Crown The Future is in a good vein of form and will be a threat if Charlie Tucker can get him into a good position from stall 12. Teggy Lasso would also need considering if the betting vibes are strong starting out for Mick Appleby and the Horse Watchers. RIDGER (IRE) CROWN THE FUTURE (IRE) TEGGY LASSO (IRE)

races.title: ARC All Weather Bonus Is Back EBF 'Confined' Restricted Maiden Stakes
races.verdict: PALMS OASIS gets the nod to make it third time lucky over C&D for the Roger Varian yard. Chapel Down will be a threat if back to the form he showed on his all-weather debut. Al Alami is open to improvement on the back of an encouraging opening run at Kempton. Bondy Boy was prominent in the betting on his intended debut at the abandoned meeting here last Saturday and it'll be interesting to see if his supporters return. PALMS OASIS CHAPEL DOWN AL ALAMI

races.title: Midnight A Next Generation Betting App Handicap
races.verdict: DRISH SAMPHIRE has upped her game since the hood was removed, winning twice in her last 3 starts, including a competitive handicap at Nottingham last month where she led close home. Despite being up 3 lb, she's fancied to follow up if proving as effective on all-weather. Up The Anti has returned to form with consecutive seconds but needs things to drop right, while Masai Angel is less exposed than most of these and could go well. DRISH SAMPHIRE (IRE) UP THE ANTI (IRE) MASAI ANGEL (FR)

races.title: AWC Season 14 Has Begun Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict: BUTTERFLY BEACH hasn't been seen since disappointing on reappearance in May but starts out for a new yard here and if she gets back to her juvenile form she'll be tough to beat. Nando Tornado showed ability along with inexperience on debut here 12 days ago and can improve, while March of Time holds claims in a race lacking in depth. BUTTERFLY BEACH (IRE) NANDO TORNADO (IRE) MARCH OF TIME (IRE)
